# Hello! 

Welcome to my Personal Website. I am currently a 6th Year PhD student at Olin Business School- WUSTL. My main research focus is on how the organization of local government affects the provision of public goods. I really enjoy studying local government because it provides a connection to many different fields within economics, finance, and a host of other disciplines.  

My job market paper, which you can check out the most recent version of in Research tab above, looks at how the organization of local government affects growth in US metropolitan areas. Growth is important to study because it helps disentangle many of the opposing theories of local government behavior. 

If you ever want to reach out to discuss my research or economics in general, please do! 

Cheers!
